questions.question: Define personal savings and explain three purposes of saving with examples.
questions.expected_answer: Personal savings: the part of income not spent now but set aside for future use. Purposes: emergencies (illness, job loss, broken appliance); short-term goals (school trip, shoes); medium-term goals (house deposit, business capital); long-term goals (education, retirement); peace of mind and independence.

questions.question: Name four barriers to saving.
questions.expected_answer: Any four: low income; rising prices; debt repayments; family responsibilities; wants, advertising and peer pressure; impulse spending; no budget or plan; saving only what is left; lack of access or knowledge about banking.

questions.question: Describe three habits that make saving easier and explain why saving is important for the economy.
questions.expected_answer: Habits (any three): set a clear goal (amount and date); pay yourself first/automatic transfer; keep savings separate; budget and track spending; wait before buying wants; save windfalls. Economy: banks lend savings to businesses and households for investment, which creates jobs and growth; low national savings means relying on foreign funding.
